day_shape: 83 items: US-Iran MoU implementation under rival readings with 60-day oil license issued and Senate war-powers rebuke, IDF fire on Hezbollah operatives near Nabatieh, Pentagon seeks $80bn for Iran war, IAEA inspections pending, heavy Qalibaf/Khamenei messaging from Baku OIC.

threads.label: US-Iran MoU implementation and disputes
threads.summary: The US-Iran memorandum is being implemented amid rival readings on Strait of Hormuz, frozen funds, inspections and oil sanctions, with Pakistan's foreign ministry saying technical talks resume next week mediated by Islamabad and Doha. Trump said Iran agreed to long-term nuclear inspections while Tehran denied the claim; Washington issued a 60-day license for Iranian crude production and sales.

threads.label: US Senate war-powers vote and Pentagon costs
threads.summary: The Republican-majority US Senate backed legislation directing Trump to halt military action against Iran, with immediate effect on operations unclear. The Pentagon told senators it needs roughly $80 billion mostly to cover the cost of the US war against Iran.

threads.label: Hezbollah ceasefire incidents near Nabatieh
threads.summary: The IDF said troops fired on four Hezbollah operatives riding a bulldozer and motorcycle into the southern Lebanon security zone on the Ali Taher ridge, with Lebanese media reporting one dead and two wounded near Nabatieh al-Fawqa. Hezbollah accused Israel of violating the ceasefire by firing on civilians; Israel-Lebanon negotiations continued in Washington with discussion of remains exchange for IAF navigator Ron.

threads.label: Qalibaf OIC speech and Khamenei messaging
threads.summary: Iran's parliament speaker Ghalibaf told an OIC meeting in Baku that Middle East security should be decided by regional countries alone, with IRIB amplifying his framing of the Islamabad memorandum as an 'American defeat'. Khamenei's office said the resistance front stands alongside Iran and credited armed forces with victories against 'American-Zionist armies in the third imposed war'.

threads.label: IAEA inspections and nuclear monitoring
threads.summary: IAEA chief Rafael Grossi said the agency will inspect Iran's facilities soon, prioritising the location of enriched uranium. Reporting noted that after two wars with Iran, IAEA nuclear material inspection procedures could incorporate significant changes.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz maritime safety
threads.summary: The IMO said it will begin a large-scale evacuation plan for over 11,000 seafarers stranded in the Strait of Hormuz, in cooperation with Iran, Oman, regional coastal states, the US and industry. EASA advised airlines to continue avoiding airspace over Iran, Iraq and Lebanon despite the Washington-Tehran framework deal.

threads.label: Iran domestic economic strain
threads.summary: Iran International reported Tehran bread prices rising by up to 100%, service disruptions at eight Iranian banks days after an outage at four others, and gym fees pushing fitness beyond reach for many households. IRIB said authorities capped nationwide rental increases at 25 per cent from the first of Tir 1405.

events.title_en: Oil minister heads to India
events.summary_en: Oil minister heads to India. Mohsen Paknejad, the oil minister, departed for India today to attend the eleventh meeting of the energy ministers of the BRICS group. At this meeting, the topic of sustainable development in the energy sector and the expansion of cooperation between BRICS members will be discussed. The oil minister will also meet with his Indian counterpart on this trip and will discuss cooperation in the fields of oil, gas, refining and petrochemicals. The development of energy cooperation between Iran and India has been announced as one of the main subjects of this trip.

events.title_en: My son, go bring me your father so I can speak with him a couple of words
events.summary_en: My son, go bring me your father so I can speak with him a couple of words. I want to tell him: pay attention to your son's future and raise him on clean values and morals. Teach him to care about himself and his life, and remove from his mind these ideas full of hypocrisy and servitude. Where will your dignity take you, and how will you face him when this poor boy grows up and discovers that all the 'illusory heroics' you're planting in his head are nothing but illusions and fabricated films and cheap theatrics? In any case, from here, from the heart of the Lebanese South, I greet you.

events.title: The IDF says troops opened fire on four Hezbollah operatives who crossed into Israel's security zone in southern Lebanon a short while ago. According to the military, troops spotted four Hezbollah operatives riding in a bulldozer and on a motorcycle into the security zone near the Ali Taher ridge, close to Nabatieh -- where troops are operating -- "in a manner that posed an immediate threat." After identifying the operatives, troops fired warning shots toward them. "After the operatives continued to approach and did not respond to the forces' calls, additional fire was carried out in order to remove the threat," the military says, adding that at least one was hit.

events.title_en: IDF forces opened fire on Hezbollah operatives operating under civilian cover on Ali al-Tahir hill after they crossed into the security zone
events.summary_en: IDF forces opened fire on Hezbollah operatives operating under civilian cover on Ali al-Tahir hill after they crossed into the security zone. IDF forces spotted four Hezbollah terrorist operatives a short time ago riding an excavator and a motorcycle on Ali al-Tahir hill, then they entered the security zone and approached the forces in a manner that posed an immediate threat. Immediately upon spotting the operatives, the forces opened fire to repel the source of the threat, but the operatives continued moving closer to the forces without heeding the forces' calls, forcing the forces to open fire towards the source of the threat to eliminate it, and they were hit.

events.summary_en: To eliminate an immediate threat: IDF attacked armed saboteurs spotted near IDF forces operating in the security zone in southern Lebanon. The IDF will continue working to eliminate immediate threats and will not allow the Hezbollah terrorist organisation to harm Israeli citizens or its forces.

events.title: Federal Acquisition Regulation: Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation Overhaul Parts 1, 2, 4, 33, 39, 40, and 53
events.summary: OFPP, DoD, GSA, and NASA (collectively referred to as the Federal Acquisition Regulatory Council or FAR Council) are proposing to amend the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) to implement Executive Order (E.O.) 14275, Restoring Common Sense to Federal Procurement. The E.O. directs the elimination of excessive acquisition regulations to stop the inefficient use of American taxpayer dollars. The FAR Council is issuing twelve proposed rules that collectively will streamline the FAR in its entirety. This rule proposes revisions to FAR parts 1, 2, 4, 33, 39, 40, 52, and 53.
